shortDescription: Find or create a GPG private key

options.name: gnupghome
options.description: Path to the GnuPG home directory. When unset, falls back to whatever C(gpg) itself uses (typically C($HOME/.gnupg)). The directory is created with mode C(0o700) if it does not exist.

options.name: gpgbinary
options.description: Name of, or path to, the C(gpg) executable.

options.name: key_length
options.description: Key length in bits. Used both as a match criterion against existing keys and as the bit length for newly generated keys.

options.name: key_type
options.description: Key algorithm. Used both as a match criterion (compared against the human-readable algorithm name C(RSA), C(DSA), C(Elgamal), C(ECDH), C(ECDSA)) and as the algorithm for newly generated keys.

options.name: name_comment
options.description: Comment portion of the GPG user ID (the text in parentheses).

options.name: name_email
options.description: Email portion of the GPG user ID (the text in angle brackets).

options.name: name_real
options.description: Real-name portion of the GPG user ID (the text before the comment / email).

options.name: passphrase
options.description: Passphrase for the secret key. When empty (the default), the generated key is unprotected (C(no_protection)). Never used to decide whether an existing key matches.

options.name: subkey_length
options.description: Length in bits of the (single) subkey to generate, and to match against existing subkeys. Only meaningful together with I(subkey_type).

options.name: subkey_type
options.description: Algorithm of the (single) subkey to generate, and to match against existing subkeys. Only meaningful together with I(subkey_length).
